messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: users are confused by inconsistent wording between the Routes console and the in-product docs flyout. Small but causing support churn.
Ravi Patel: can you list the mismatches?
Nina Park: flyout says 'Variant' and 'Runtime tier'; Routes list shows 'Serving variant' and 'Capacity tier'. Two customers tried to 'pin capacity tier' instead of the model variant.
Clara Gomez: that taxonomy overlap is the problem. product needs a canonical pair.
Jonah Reed: proposal: 'Model variant' + 'Instance tier'. Model-centric term for the model choice, infra term for resource sizing.
Ravi Patel: Docs suggestion: produce a single canonical permalink pattern and expose a "Copy permalink" in the flyout. Example canonical link: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/routes?routeId=abc123&section=variant
Nina Park: also accessibility issues: the flyout's 'Open docs' control is not keyboard-focusable and lacks an aria-label when collapsed — screenreader reads "button" only.
Clara Gomez: action items: 1) Product (Clara) to finalize lexicon (aim EOD Mon). 2) Docs (Ravi) to add canonical permalink pattern + copy snippet in docs. 3) Eng-UI (Jonah) to update labels + make flyout anchor keyboard-focusable and add aria-label. 4) Support (Nina) to update KB examples.
Ravi Patel: I'll draft the canonical copy and link examples and post them here mid-week. Will include aria-label recommendations.
Jonah Reed: I'll open a small PR for label text (i18n keys) and an accessibility PR to add tabindex and proper aria attributes. Will run axe/VoiceOver tests.
Nina Park: please also check other nearby terms (quota vs limit, capacity vs instance) and drop them here if found.
Clara Gomez: I'll run a quick poll with PMs to confirm the lexicon.
Nina Park: great, thanks. small fixes but should cut a chunk of these support questions. :thumbsup:
